title: THE WHAT IS NEW CARD NAMES THE STATUS ICONS
why: The card was stamped v18.99 and the stamp may not trail the build by more than 0.15. Its new second line names the status icons down the left (v19.00), the sector map names that no longer overlap (v19.02), the death card pictures (v19.04) and the extraction card haul (v19.05).
now: The what is new card names the status icons and the clearer cards.
